senses.gloss: m. (דָּכַס, cmp. Arab. dakasan) masses stamped upon each other, mounds, piles.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> (play on <he>דָּכְיָם</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 93:3">Ps. XCIII, 3</cite>) <he>לד׳ ים</he> <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 848">Yalk. Ps. 848</cite> (ed. Gen. R. <he>לדוכסאים</he>, <he>לדיכ׳</he>) unto the piled up waters of the Sea.
